topups.why: 'aros' could be heard as waiting or as staying, and 그 사무실 ('that office') could add a 'that' the Welsh doesn't have. The meaning is also odd. The other five are stronger.

originals.why: It is grammatical. The meaning is a bit thin, and spoken North Welsh would more often say 'fy stafell i', but it is not wrong.

originals.why: It has the same Korean as o9. 'dw i 'di' is just the spoken short form of 'dw i wedi', so the learner still has only one answer.
